# Time budgets for go test, read by internal/testtime.
#   leaf SECONDS                  a test that has no subtests
#   package PATH|default SECONDS  wall time of one package; PATH@JOB sets it for one job
#   test PATH NAME SECONDS        tests of PATH whose name starts with NAME
# Rule: a package budget is 1.5 times the slowest of six CI runs on 2026-10-13, with a floor of 10 s.
# A leaf budget is 10 s; a slower test has a test line with its reason. A test with subtests is not
# checked, because parallel parents report the time of the whole package. A change that makes a test
# or package slower raises its number in the same diff and states why.
#
# Package        slowest CI run  budget
# e2e (Contract)         77 s     116 s (the jj rows run jj for each fixture)
# e2e@runtime        101.36 s    153 s (each runtime scenario checks every log prefix against replay)
# claudecode             14 s      21 s
# imageclamp            8.3 s      13 s
# gates                 24 s       36 s (cold build of the fake CLI)
# server                7.5 s      12 s
# plugin                1.4 s      75 s (two sequential node probes with a 30 s deadline each)
# . (root)             10.1 s      16 s (usually 3.5 s; 7-10 s on a slow runner)
# workspace              12 s      18 s (each jj contract row builds its repository with jj)
# any other              <6 s      10 s
leaf 10
package default 10
package e2e 116
package e2e@runtime 153
package internal/backend/claudecode 21
package internal/imageclamp 13
package internal/gates 36
package internal/server 12
package internal/plugin 75
package . 16
package internal/workspace 18

# The node probes of the TypeScript SDK tests have a 30 s deadline, as a configured plugin
# has; a cold node start on a loaded runner can use most of it.
test internal/plugin TestTypeScriptSDK 35

# The gates run the whole repository against the merge base.
test internal/gates TestRepository 12

# The first test of the package to start a runtime builds the fake CLI (up to 14.01 s on CI, budget 1.5 times).
test internal/backend/claudecode TestClaudeCodeCreateRefusesAnUnknownTool 18
test internal/backend/claudecode TestClaudeCodeRoutesTheSelectedAccountThroughTheProxy 22
# Each row restarts a runtime over a CLI-backed session and replays a large saved state. It takes 7 s alone and 16-41 s on CI, where it runs beside the whole parallel package. The state must pass the 4 MiB chunk and the sync batch cap, and the race detector spends the time decoding it.
test e2e TestContractRuntimeClaudeCodeStateChunks 60
# The search edge row checks each log prefix (20.90 s on CI).
test e2e TestContractFileToolsEdges/runtime/file_tools_search_edges 32
# The race detector processes a compressible state over the 128 MiB checkpoint limit (28.76 s locally).
test e2e TestContractOversizedCheckpoint/runtime/oversized_uncompressed_checkpoint_is_not_saved 44
# Rows that build a large transcript for a goal evaluator (7-12 s on CI).
test e2e TestContractGoalEvaluatorTranscript 18
# Rows that wait for a real hook timeout (6 s on CI).
test e2e TestContractPluginHookTimeouts 15
# Rows that stop a server and wait for its sync report (5 s on CI).
test e2e TestContractServeStopReportsCrashed 15
# Rows that start a real MCP server process (5 s on CI).
test e2e TestContractRuntimeSessionMCP 15
# Rows that run git on a fixture repository (9 s under load locally).
test e2e TestContractWorkspace 15
# A row that pages the skill list of a server past 100 pages and reads each file it checks (10.4 s on CI).
test e2e TestContractMCPSkillVerification/runtime/mcp_skill_listed_beyond_page_100 16
test e2e TestContractMCPSkillVerification/serve/mcp_skill_listed_beyond_page_100 16

# Builds the fake CLI; a cold build cache makes it 7 s to 21 s on CI (24 s for the package).
test internal/gates TestWireDoublesMatchTheRealWire 32
